title.en: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES PROVIDING FOR THE ADOPTION OF THE NATIONAL HOUSEHOLD TARGETING SYSTEM FOR POVERTY REDUCTION AS THE MECHANISM FOR IDENTIFYING POOR HOUSEHOLDS WHO SHALL RECIPIENTS SOCIAL PROTECTION NATIONWIDE

text.en:
All national government agencies (NGs) are directed to
adopt the NHTS-PR as a mechanism in identifying who and where the poor
households who shall be recipients of social protection programs nationwide are.

The DSWD shall maintain the system and serve as the
repository of the data on poor households and shall update the data every four
PGMA Hologram * 55228

All GAs shall use the data generated by the system in
prioritizing beneficiaries of government's social protection programs and projects.

The DSWD, in coordination with the Social Security System
(SSS, the National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA), the National
Statistics Office (NO) as well as all other agencies involved in the Unified Multi-
Purpose Identification (UMID) System project, shall work for the adoption of the
UMID, upon its operationalization, as the main ID system of the NHTS-PR in
order to further strengthen the monitoring of beneficiaries of social welfare and
protection programs of the national government.

Any executive issuance, order or provision inconsistent with
the provisions of this Executive Order is deemed modified or repealed.

This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this
Our Lord, Two Thousand and Ten.
